description: Implementation of the SPDY protocol frame serialization and deserialization, including frame building, encoding, and handling of various SPDY frame types such as HEADERS, PUSH_PROMISE, DATA, SETTINGS, PING, and GOAWAY.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for serializing SPDY frames, handling different frame types and encoding frames into output buffer.

classes.name: SpdyHeaderFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for SPDY HEADERS frames, manages encoding headers with potential continuation frames.

classes.name: SpdyPushPromiseFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for SPDY PUSH_PROMISE frames, manages encoding push promise frames.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for control frames, serializes a single frame.

classes.name: FrameSerializationVisitor
classes.description: Visitor pattern implementation for serializing different SPDY frame IRs into frames.

classes.name: FrameSerializationVisitorWithOutput
classes.description: Visitor for serializing frames directly into a provided output buffer.

classes.name: FlagsSerializationVisitor
classes.description: Visitor for serializing frame flags based on frame IRs.

methods.name: SerializeHeadersBuilderHelper
methods.description: Prepares header frame size, flags, and HPACK encoding for serialization.

methods.name: SerializePushPromiseBuilderHelper
methods.description: Prepares push promise frame size, flags, and HPACK encoding.

methods.name: SerializeDataBuilderHelper
methods.description: Calculates flags and size for data frames with padding.

methods.name: SerializeDataFrameHeaderWithPaddingLengthFieldBuilderHelper
methods.description: Calculates size and flags for data frames with padding length field.

methods.name: SerializeSettingsBuilderHelper
methods.description: Prepares size and flags for SETTINGS frames.

methods.name: SerializeAltSvcBuilderHelper
methods.description: Prepares size and value string for ALTSVC frames.
